name: Setup git-daemon + webserver on port 8080
recipe_commands: apt-get update && apt-get install -y git nginx
git config --global user.email 'test@example.com' && git config --global user.name 'Test'
cd /git/server && git config core.bare false && git config core.worktree /srv/www
mkdir -p /srv/www && cd /srv/www && git init && echo 'hello world' > hello.html && git add . && git commit -m 'init'

cd /git/server && cat > hooks/post-receive << 'HEOF'
#!/bin/sh
GIT_WORK_TREE=/srv/www git checkout -f master
HEOF
chmod +x hooks/post-receive
service nginx start || nginx -s reload || nginx
reasoning: Setup bare git repo + post-receive hook syncs to /srv/www. nginx MUST listen on 8080 (not default 80). ALWAYS verify with curl http://localhost:8080/hello.html at the end.
